overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Monaco Limited Edition 6-Person PureTech Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a luxurious and health-enhancing experience right in your home. Designed for ultimate relaxation and wellness, this spacious sauna features 16 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels, promoting muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Natural Canadian Hemlock wood and equipped with a chromotherapy lighting system, it transforms any indoor space—such as a fitness room or master bath—into a personal retreat. Enjoy seamless connectivity with a built-in DVD player, FM radio, and Bluetooth, making it a perfect blend of comfort and modern technology.
